JOBS_STARTED: Shift started, follow the route on the map
JOBS_ERR_GONE: That is not your current stop
JOBS_ERR_JOB: This work needs the right job
JOBS_ERR_NO_STOPS: This route has no stops yet
JOBS_ERR_VEHICLE: The work vehicle could not be brought out
ADMIN_TAB_ROUTES_DESC: Jobs anyone (or a job's members) can start at a depot: driving routes and gathering.
ADMIN_DELETE_ROUTE: Delete this route? Its stops stay and can be reused.
ADMIN_C_ROUTE_DESC: Where the work starts and how the stops follow each other.
ADMIN_H_KIND: Random: the next stop is any other stop (taxi, trucker). In order: stops one after the other (bus). Gather: on foot, items at each stop.
ADMIN_H_DEPOT: Where players start and stop working.
ADMIN_H_STOPS: 0 means the shift goes on until the player stops.
ADMIN_H_SECONDS: How long the work at a stop takes.
ADMIN_C_VEHICLE_DESC: Driving routes give the worker a vehicle and pay per stop.
ADMIN_H_VEHICLE: Spawn name (taxi, bus, mule, trash). Empty: no vehicle.
ADMIN_H_PAY: Paid to the bank after each stop.
ADMIN_C_GATHER_DESC: Gathering routes give items instead of money.
ADMIN_H_ITEM: One to three of this item per stop.
ADMIN_TAB_STOPS_DESC: The places a route visits; each stop names its route.
ADMIN_C_STOP_DESC: Stand at the place and use your position.
ADMIN_H_ROUTE: The id of the route this stop belongs to (taxi, bus...).
